task.treasurer: prepare the payment at the bank
task.secretary: make the payment at the bank
task.secretary_hint: Click the button once you have made the payment at the bank. The claim is then marked as paid and everyone, including the submitter, knows it has been paid.
portal.edit_hint: Details can be changed until the chair has approved.
portal.new_intro: Create a claim on someone's behalf. If you fill in all details it goes straight to the chair. If you leave them empty, the submitter receives an email with a link to complete them.
portal.new_intro_member: Add a photo or PDF of your receipt. If you fill in all details the claim goes straight to the chair. If you leave them empty, you will receive an email with a link to complete them later.
public.title: Expense claim {reference}
public.intro: Please fill in the details below. Your claim will then be sent to the chair for approval.
public.remember: Remember my bank account and account holder for next time
public.saved: Thank you! Your details have been saved. You will receive an email at every step.
error.iban: This is not a valid IBAN.
error.amount: Enter a valid amount, for example 12.50.
error.login_locked: Too many failed attempts. Please try again in 15 minutes.
error.password_short: The password must be at least 10 characters.
error.user_exists: A user with this email already exists.
error.file_type: Only PDFs and photos (jpg, png, heic, webp) up to the maximum size are allowed.
error.file_required: Add at least one receipt or invoice.
error.not_allowed: You are not allowed to perform this step.
error.wrong_status: This step is not (or no longer) possible for this claim.
error.claim_locked: This claim can no longer be changed.
stamp.title: APPROVED
mail.received.subject: Expense claim {reference} received
mail.received.body:
Dear {name},

We have received your expense claim ({count} attachment(s)).

Please use this link to enter the amount, a description, your bank account and account holder:
{link}

The claim can only be approved after that. You will receive an email at every step.

Kind regards,
{org}
mail.no_attachment.subject: Expense claim not received: no attachment
mail.no_attachment.body:
Hello,

Your email did not contain a receipt or invoice. Please send your claim again with a photo or PDF of the receipt attached.

Kind regards,
{org}
mail.status.subject: Expense claim {reference}: {status}
mail.task.subject: Action needed: expense claim {reference}
mail.reminder.subject: Reminder: {count} expense claim(s) waiting for you
mail.reminder_submitter.subject: Reminder: complete your expense claim {reference}
help.title: Help
help.yours: Highlighted: the sections for your role(s).
preview.unavailable: No preview available; open the attachment via the link.
update.not_configured: Updating from the portal is not set up on this server. Run the install script deploy/install-vps.sh once more, or update from the command line (see docs/bijwerken.md).
update.running: Updating. This can take a few minutes, during which the tool is briefly unavailable. This page refreshes by itself. If you see an error, refresh it yourself after a minute.
update.failed: The last update failed. The previous version is still running. See the log below.
update.version_mismatch: The running version differs from the installed version. The restart may have failed, or (with the GitHub image) the new image was not ready yet. Try again later.
update.fetch_failed: Could not reach GitHub during the last check.
update.note: The server checks for a new version every hour. It only updates when you press the button.
backup.title: Backup
backup.stale: The last backup is from {when}. That is too long ago: the nightly backup is not running. Check on the server with  journalctl -u declaratietool-backup.
backup.failed: The last backup failed ({when}). Check on the server with  journalctl -u declaratietool-backup.
backup.not_configured: No backups are being made yet. Set them up with  sudo deploy/backup.sh setup  on the server (see docs/backup.md).
backup.note: Every night an encrypted backup of the database, attachments and settings is sent to Google Drive.
backup.warning: Warning: the backup is not working.
error.update.not_configured: Updating from the portal is not set up on this server.
error.update.busy: A check or update is already running. Wait until it has finished.
users.self_note: Your own account stays active and keeps the Administrator role, so you cannot lock yourself out.
users.delete_plain: This account will be deleted permanently.
users.delete_history: This user appears in the history of claims. The account is therefore not erased but disabled and anonymised, so the log stays correct.
error.delete_self: You cannot delete your own account.
mail.intro: Set up the mailbox the tool uses to send mail (SMTP) and to fetch receipts (IMAP). What you save here takes precedence over the values in .env and applies immediately, without a restart. Passwords are stored encrypted and never shown.
mail.smtp_help: Leave the server empty to only log mails instead of sending them.
mail.imap_help: Every unread mail in this folder becomes a claim. Leave the server empty to not fetch mail.
mail.clear_passwords: Clear empty password fields instead of keeping them
mail.test_note: The test buttons use what is in the form now, without saving. An empty password field tests with the saved password.
mail.test_smtp_ok: SMTP connection works: connected and logged in. Don't forget to save.
mail.test_imap_ok: IMAP connection works: logged in and folder opened ({detail} unread). Don't forget to save.
mail.saved: Mail settings saved. They apply immediately.
mail.reset_help: This deletes all mail settings saved here, including passwords. The values from .env apply again afterwards.
mail.reset_done: The saved mail settings were deleted; the values from .env apply again.
error.port: Enter a port number between 1 and 65535.
log.subject: Subject
log.retention: Entries are deleted automatically after {days} days.
users.read_only: Only an administrator can add or change users.
claim.edit_intro: As an administrator you can always change the details, even after approval. The status does not change and the submitter gets no email, unless you change the email address and tick the box below. The change is recorded in the history.
claim.delete_warning: The claim is permanently deleted, including all attachments, the history and the internal notes. This cannot be undone.
claim.delete_check: Yes, I am sure I want to delete this claim
comments.title: Internal notes
comments.hint: Only the chair, treasurer, secretary and administrator see these notes. They are not shown on the submitter's page or in emails.
error.delete_confirm: Tick the box first to confirm you really want to delete the claim.
comments.tooltip: {count} internal note(s), not visible to submitter. Latest:
notify.intro: Choose which events you want to receive an e-mail about. This is your own setting; the e-mails go to {email}, in the language you chose under your name.
notify.option.login_help: An e-mail for every successful login, including your own.
notify.option.lockout_help: An e-mail as soon as an e-mail address or IP address is blocked for 15 minutes after too many failed attempts.
notify.option.mail_help: An e-mail for every message in the claims mailbox, with what happened to it. Automatic messages (such as out-of-office replies) are not included.
notify.login.subject: [{app}] {user} logged in
notify.lockout.subject: [{app}] Temporary login block for {email}
notify.lockout.by_account: too many attempts for this e-mail address
notify.lockout.by_ip: too many attempts from this IP address
notify.mail.subject: [{app}] E-mail received from {sender}
login2fa.recovery_hint: No access to your app or your e-mail? Enter one of your recovery codes instead. Each recovery code works only once.
error.code_wrong: This code is incorrect or has expired. Try the latest code.
2fa.title: Two-step verification
2fa.intro: Extra security: after your password you also enter a code. Choose how you receive that code:
2fa.step_app: Install an authenticator app on your phone, or open the one you already use (Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator, Bitwarden, 1Password, Aegis, …).
2fa.step_scan: In the app, choose to add a new account and scan this QR code.
2fa.qr_alt: QR code for your authenticator app
2fa.manual: Can't scan? Type in this key instead:
2fa.step_code: Enter the 6-digit code the app shows now.
2fa.codes_intro: Keep these recovery codes somewhere safe, for example in your password manager. If you lose your phone, a recovery code still lets you log in. Each code works once.
2fa.codes_once: These codes are shown only once.
2fa.codes_left: You have {count} unused recovery code(s) left.
2fa.reset_help: Use this when this user has lost both their phone and their recovery codes. They can then log in with just their password and set up two-step verification again.
login2fa.intro_app: Open your authenticator app (for example Google Authenticator or Bitwarden) and enter the 6-digit code.
login2fa.intro_email: We have sent a 6-digit code to your e-mail address. The code is valid for 10 minutes.
error.code_resend_wait: Please wait a minute before requesting a new code.
2fa.mail_resent: A new code has been sent.
2fa.mail.subject: [{app}] Your login code
2fa.mail.body:
Hello {name},

Your login code for {app} is:

{code}

The code is valid for {minutes} minutes.

Didn't try to log in? Then someone else knows your password. Please change it as soon as possible.
2fa.option_app: Authenticator app on your phone, such as Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator or Bitwarden. The most secure option, and works without internet.
2fa.option_email: Code by e-mail. Easy, but only as secure as your mailbox.
2fa.email_sent: We have sent a 6-digit code to {email}. Enter it below to turn on two-step verification.
2fa.status_on_app: Two-step verification is on, with an authenticator app.
2fa.status_on_email: Two-step verification is on, with a code by e-mail.
undo.intro: The last step ({step}) will be reverted and the claim returns to its previous status. The submitter will be notified.
view_as.help: See the portal exactly as this person sees it, to help or explain. You cannot approve, save or send anything meanwhile. This is recorded in the log.
view_as.blocked: That is not possible while viewing as someone else. Stop viewing first.
simple.setting_help: After signing in you only see what is waiting for you, with large buttons. Settings and New claim are hidden from the menu.
simple.setting_help_admin: For chair, treasurer or secretary: only their own tasks, large buttons, no settings in the menu. The person can also switch this on or off under their name.
simple.title: Hello {name}
simple.intro: {count} claims are waiting for you. Click a claim to view it.
simple.nothing: Nothing is waiting for you right now. You will get an e-mail as soon as there is something to do.
simple.intro_one: 1 claim is waiting for you. Click it to view it.
notify.option.new_claim_help: An e-mail as soon as a claim comes in, by e-mail or through the portal. Claims you create yourself are not sent.
notify.option.status_help: An e-mail for every step: details completed, approved, payment prepared, paid, rejected or a step undone. Not for steps you take yourself, and not when the claim then waits for you: you already get an e-mail with your task.
notify.option.overdue_help: One e-mail per task as soon as a claim has been in the same step for longer than the chosen number of days, also when someone else is up. Sent along with the daily reminders.
notify.new_claim.subject: [{app}] New expense claim {reference}
notify.status.subject: [{app}] {reference}: {status}
notify.overdue.subject: [{app}] {count} expense claim(s) open for more than {days} days
offline.title: No connection
offline.text: You are offline. As soon as you are back online, you can continue with your claims.
badge.allow_help: On iPhone and iPad the app icon shows how many tasks are waiting for you once you allow notifications. This does not send you any extra messages.
mail.approve_link:
Approve directly without logging in (the link works once, until {until}):
{link}
approve_link.intro: Check the claim and the receipts. If everything is correct, click the button. Your initials will then be added to the receipts.
approve_link.changed: The details changed since you opened this page. Please check them again before approving.
approve_link.other: Not okay, or want to ask something first? Log in to reject or add a comment:
approve_link.problem.used: This link has already been used.
approve_link.problem.handled: This claim is no longer waiting for approval via this link. Log in to see where it stands.
approve_link.problem.expired: This link has expired. Log in to view the claim, or use the link from the latest reminder.
approve_link.problem.disabled: Approving by link is not (or no longer) enabled for your account. Log in to view the claim.
approve_link.setting: May approve via a link in the email (without logging in)
approve_link.setting_help: Only for the chair. The email about a new claim and the daily reminder then contain a link to approve directly. The link works once, only for that claim, and expires after a few days. Anyone who can read the email can therefore approve; the treasurer and secretary still check afterwards.
claim.edit_resend: If you change the email address: send the submitter the link and current status at the new address
attachment.replace_intro: Upload a new version, for example a signed invoice. The old file is removed and the replacement is recorded in the history.
attachment.replace_intro_stamped: Upload a new version, for example an invoice signed by hand. The new file gets the same initials stamp as at approval (name and time). The old file is removed and the replacement is recorded in the history.
edited.name: name
log.result.ignored_reply: Reply to an earlier mail; no new claim
mail.reply_ignored.subject: Your reply about claim {reference}
mail.reply_ignored.body:
Hello,

We received your reply to the email about claim {reference}. Replies to our emails are not submitted as a new claim, not even when they have an attachment.

Want to claim a new receipt? Please send a new email (not a reply) with the receipt attached.

Kind regards,
{org}
